messages:
maya: weekend challenge  I'm making snacks and want a 30min 'indie dinner' playlist + a 4020min movie/mini-doc to watch while things bake. cozy but not sleepy. any faves? :plate_with_cutlery:
glen: for music, try a mix of Devendra Banhart -> Camera Obscura -> Toro y Moi. keeps it upbeat but mellow. movie: 'Once' is ~85m so too long, but 'The Lunch Date' (short) is sweet if you want 12m.
sophie: mini-doc rec: 'Edith and the Kingpin' is longer. hmm. there's a 40min episode of 'Chef's Table: BBQ' episode segments sometimes hit ~40 and are super watchable while you prep.
raj: quick playlist idea (30m): 1) Bahamas - "Lost In The Light" 2) Alvvays - "Dreams Tonite" 3) Mac DeMarco - "My Kind of Woman" 4) Joanna Newson - short track 5) Khruangbin - "People Everywhere" -> total ~32min.
maya: loving the Khruangbin rec. anyone have a playlist link so I don't have to build it? :sweat_smile:
playlist-bot: Created playlist "maya-indie-dinner"  9 tracks  31m total. Link: https://music.internal/playlists/maya-indie-dinner
sophie: snack rec: browned butter mushrooms on toast, broil for 2min. fast and fancy. also pro tip: set a kitchen timer to the length of a short doc and call it your "watch-until-ding" ritual :alarm_clock:
glen: if you want an offbeat 40min watch: try 'My Winnipeg' directors cut bits (Guy Maddin)  surreal but strangely comforting.
raj: or for pure comfort watch: 'A Film About Coffee' (70m) if you can stretch the bake time. it's relaxing.
maya: thank you all! playlist queued, mushrooms planned. will report back with a pic and possibly extra muffins for whoever wants one :camera_with_flash: :muffin:
sophie: pics or it didn't happen :joy:
